approaches.title: Index stack scan
approaches.summary: Uses a stack of unmatched-parenthesis indices with a sentinel boundary to compute the longest valid substring in one pass.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implements the standard one-pass stack algorithm, tracking indices of unmatched opening parentheses and boundaries.

approaches.title: Bidirectional balance scans
approaches.summary: Scans the string from both directions while tracking opening and closing counts, resetting when balance becomes invalid. The reverse scan handles cases that the forward scan cannot capture.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 32: another copied solution, more intuitive
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces the stack with forward and reverse balance scans to find the maximum balanced span.

revisions.commitComment: first time using generics and lifetimes
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 32: first time using generics and lifetimes
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Refactors the two scans into a generic iterator-based helper with an explicit opening-parenthesis parameter, preserving the bidirectional balance strategy.
